brief: A three-storey spice tower for the kitchen counter, one cell wide, with a bin on each storey.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0 full with riser; stacking a second/third full base on a cell holding a bin is refused by the configurator (no piece offer at level 1), so only one storey stands.
bin:0,0,0 hex-bin-full-div3 in the single cell; upper-storey bins could not be placed because upper bases cannot stack over a bin cell.
single-cell tower with divided bin suits countertop spice sorting; no spice-jar props exist in catalog.
requirements.requirement: for the kitchen counter as a spice tower

finish.summary: Single-cell base with one 3-compartment bin built. Three-storey stacking with a bin per storey is refused by the configurator (a base cannot stack on a cell holding a bin), so the tower could not be completed.

events.text: Building your three-storey spice tower — one cell wide with a bin on every level.
